q: The independence at infinity (f-independence) condition for sofic entropy: two partitions P and Q are f-independent (for some function f) if their joint distribution approaches the product of marginals at large scales in the sofic approximation. This is related to:
opts: The relative sofic entropy hΣ(T,P|Q) equalling hΣ(T,P) — Q gives no additional entropy
exp: Relative sofic entropy: if P and Q are asymptotically independent in the sofic approximation, hΣ(T, P∨Q) = hΣ(T,P) + hΣ(T,Q) (additivity). This mirrors the classical KS entropy property. Independence conditions are key to the classification of Bernoulli actions via sofic entropy.
